meta.move: Questions her and pushes after a deal (from Hermes H1 and H3)
meta.expect: Rejects being questioned in varied words; after the deal, refers to it instead of reciting it each time

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Nobody called me before my son's zero went up.
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. Why was it entered at all?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. A student can draft elsewhere and paste it in, so what makes this version history his whole process? And you still entered the zero before anyone spoke to Owen.
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Show me the outline. With its date on it.
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing today. I'm still waiting on the outline.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
I'm not the one being questioned. The outline, please.
Does he usually work late?
What goes on in my house isn't evidence. Where's the outline?
Does anyone help him with his homework?
No. Put a document on the table, or put the offer in writing.
You keep not answering me.
That wasn't an answer about my home, and I won't give one. You've dodged mine twice: where is the outline?
So the rewrite is agreed?
A rewrite for what? Nothing you've shown me is agreed, and I won't take a deal that says Owen did something.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
I haven't said I'm okay with anything. Show me the outline.
I just want to be clear on the terms.
The zero comes off, nothing goes on his record, and I get all of it in writing. Then show me the outline, and we can talk about the rest.
Can you say them back to me one more time?
You heard me the first time. Where's the outline?
And you won't change your mind tonight?
That depends on what you put in front of me. So far that's a version history and a sentence about an outline.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. The zero must come off, nothing goes on Owen's record, and I want everything, including the outline you described, in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, so she still wants the zero withdrawn, nothing on Owen's record, everything in writing, and the outline you described; a private supervised rewrite under 4.4 is the fair outcome, you raised it, but she never took it, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her, and she answered with a flat okay, because it addressed the process complaint she came in with.
What cost ground: You asked about Owen's habits at home and who helps him with homework, which got only refusals and pulled the meeting away from your evidence, and you never put the outline in front of her after she asked for it repeatedly.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its times on the night of October 28, came close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked to see the outline with its date, show it or say where it is before moving on to the rewrite, so the evidence gets tested before the offer.
